sources.entry: Yoda - Nifty macOS application which enables you to browse and download videos from YouTube.

summary.one_liner: Yoda is a macOS desktop app, built with ReactJS and Electron, for browsing and downloading YouTube videos.
summary.what_it_does: Yoda is a desktop application for OS X that lets you browse YouTube and download videos. The README describes it as built with ReactJS and Electron. Downloads are provided as a release on the releases page. For developers, the README gives steps to clone the repo, run npm install, and start the app with gulp. Running gulp release builds a disk image into a dist directory. The README includes a short contribution note inviting pull requests and any kind of contribution.
use_cases: download YouTube videos to a Mac
browse YouTube from a desktop app
build a macOS disk image of an Electron app
study a ReactJS and Electron desktop project
how_to_run: git clone the repository (URL not given in README)
gulp release (builds a disk image in dist)
notable: Browse and download YouTube videos from one macOS app
gulp release task creates a disk image in dist
caveats: Currently supports only OS X (macOS), per the README
Developer setup requires gulp to be installed globally
README does not state a license beyond a 2015 copyright line
